title: Exact non-parent review read: same resultId succeeds for one same-project root and returns 404 'no confirmed publication' for another
outcome: Exact non-parent review read: same resultId succeeds for one same-project root and returns 404 'no confirmed publication' for another
acceptance: A source-cited diagnosis explains why Engram::Merger (session-11859) received 404 'review attempt has no confirmed publication' at about 07:47:55Z for the exact C1 review reads that non-parent Engram::Coder-MacosFixSol (session-12325) completed successfully with the same delegationId, submissionAttempt and resultId; it names whether the cause is timing of publication capture, caller project or root mapping, or a defect
If it is a defect, a deterministic test shows two eligible same-project non-parent roots get the same answer for the same exact identity, and the fix lands through the normal review pair and gate
If it is timing or caller mapping by design, the refusal text tells the caller what is missing and the contract is documented in docs/features/review-attempt-retention.md
disposal_reason: Root cause identified by Engram::Coder-MacosFixSol #124: Merger's exact reads passed delegationId as the BARE UUID 'd69e5d7d-3c69-413e-968a-15b85ffd50a6', while 12325's successful reads used the canonical 'delegation-d69e5d7d-…'. That is exactly existing bug w-81435dcf92ef, where a bare UUID yields a misleading 404 'review attempt has no confirmed publication' instead of resolving or refusing the id form. Supported route for Merger: re-read with the canonical 'delegation-' prefixed id. Evidence: Engram w-dd205 fda5059b37aa4a4c954c7a35fc93c619 and 527af481e4884be98677c4f954935aef.
